content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TNGCL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TNGCL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the TNGCL Recruitment 2026 is 09 October 2026. Ensure all details are submitted correctly before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TNGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the TNGCL Recruitment 2026. These positions are for Deputy General Manager (O & M) Grade-M7, Assistant Manager-BIS Grade-M2, and Assistant Manager-Fire & Safety, Grade-M2.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Deputy General Manager post?
faq.answer: For the Deputy General Manager (O & M) Grade-M7 post, candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering Discipline (Mechanical/ Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Chemical/ Civil) with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for TNGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the TNGCL Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Manager-BIS Grade-M2 and Assistant Manager-Fire & Safety, Grade-M2 posts is Rs.10.62 Lakhs per annum. This is a competitive salary package for the role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for TNGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the TNGCL Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official TNGCL website to fill out and submit their application forms.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification for TNGCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification for TNGCL Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q8. What is the start date for online applications?
faq.answer: The online registration and submission of applications for TNGCL Recruitment 2026 commenced on 19 September 2026. Candidates can start applying from this date onwards.

faq.question: Q9. Does TNGCL offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for specific details on age relaxation policies.
